metadata.description: Claude Code skills for architects working in Revit, Rhino and the AEC toolchain.

plugins.name: archi-magic
plugins.description: AEC skills for Claude Code. All skills are prefixed am-*. Also installs superpowers and frontend-design.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: General work skills by Jesse Vincent (obra), MIT: brainstorming, writing and executing plans, systematic debugging, test-driven development, code review, verification before completion. Pinned to v7.0.1.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic's frontend design skill: distinctive, production-grade web interfaces instead of generic AI-looking pages. Pinned to v1.1.0.

plugins.name: am-bim-viewer
plugins.description: Mod: /bim-view builds an interactive 3D BIM viewer page (Rhino-style camera, element data panel) from a Revit JSON export. Needs a Claude Code build with function hooks (tested on 2.1.299).

plugins.name: am-schedule-view
plugins.description: Mod for the am-schedule-view skill: /am-schedule-view <file.json> shows a Revit schedule or change preview in a pane. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.299.

plugins.name: rhino-mcp
plugins.description: McNeel's official Rhino MCP plugin (MIT): lets Claude read and edit the open Rhino 8 document. On demand: needs Rhino 8, Node.js and the Rhino-MCP-Platform Rhino package. Run am-rhino-setup first.
